admissions.q: When does the application period begin?
admissions.a: Applications open after each information session. Exact dates are on the Visits & Info Sessions page.

admissions.q: Can my child join with no English at all?
admissions.a: Our kindergarten programme is designed so children new to English can adapt step by step.
Mid-year entry is possible where places are available. Please contact the campus.
Examination fees are on the Admissions page; tuition varies by campus and class (demo figures).

academics.a: Exploring the world through English, building confidence, creativity and collaboration.
Native-speaking teachers and specialist teachers run small classes together.

academics.q: What is the main language of instruction?
academics.a: The day runs in English, with Korean support by age.

academics.q: What does a typical day look like?
academics.a: A balanced day of English play, songs, PE and music.
